notes: «سمعت المغيرة بن الضحاك» : the one heard is a link (rule 5)
«عن أمها» is a relation link; her servant «مولاة لها», who asked Umm Salama and brought back the answer, is unnamed
Umm Salama is the last link; the Prophet's words inside her account are not a separate chain
«قال أحمد الصواب بكحل الجلاء» is a remark on wording; left out
